content.title: IPL 2026 Standings: Updated Points Table After Gujarat Titans vs Kolkata Knight Riders Match
content.text: Gujarat Titans vs Kolkata Knight Riders Standings: Gujarat Titans moved up to fourth place in the Indian Premier League 2026 points table after defeating Kolkata Knight Riders by five wickets at the Narendra Modi Stadium on Friday, April 17, 2026. Chasing a target of 180, Gujarat completed the chase in 19.4 overs, thanks to a match-winning knock from captain Shubman Gill.IPL 2026 GT vs KKR Full Scorecard: Click HereGill scored 86 off 50 balls, registering his third consecutive half-century and guiding his side to their third win of the season. The victory took Gujarat Titans to six points from five matches.Kolkata Knight Riders, meanwhile, continued their poor run, remaining at the bottom of the table with just one point from six matches.Gujarat Titans Move Into Top FourPunjab Kings continue to lead the standings with nine points, followed by Royal Challengers Bengaluru and Rajasthan Royals, who are placed second and third respectively with eight points each.Gujarat Titans now occupy the fourth position with six points, pushing Sunrisers Hyderabad to fifth. Delhi Capitals, Lucknow Super Giants and Chennai Super Kings follow next, all tied on four points.Mumbai Indians remain ninth with two points, while Kolkata Knight Riders sit at the bottom after failing to register a win so far this season.Updated IPL 2026 Points Table (After Match 25)PositionTeamMatchesWinsLossesNRPointsNRR1Punjab Kings540191.0672Royal Challengers Bengaluru541081.5033Rajasthan Royals541080.8894Gujarat Titans532060.0185Sunrisers Hyderabad523040.5766Delhi Capitals422040.3227Lucknow Super Giants52304-0.8048Chennai Super Kings52304-0.8469Mumbai Indians51402-1.07610Kolkata Knight Riders60511-1.149Orange Cap updateShubman Gill has taken the lead in the Orange Cap standings with 251 runs in IPL 2026, moving ahead of Virat Kohli. Heinrich Klaasen, Rajat Patidar and Ishan Kishan complete the top five run-scorers list.Purple Cap updatePrasidh Krishna continues to lead the Purple Cap race with 11 wickets, followed by Anshul Kamboj with 10 wickets. Prince Yadav and Ravi Bishnoi are also among the top wicket-takers this season.Upcoming matchesRoyal Challengers Bengaluru will face Delhi Capitals at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium, while Chennai Super Kings will take on Sunrisers Hyderabad in Hyderabad on April 18.
